name: smart-comments
description: Reads each comment Claude adds, lets through the ones that tell a reader what the code cannot, skips docstrings, and names the lines to cut.

maxPlain.title: Plain comments allowed
maxPlain.description: How many new comment lines that add little an edit, or a file over one turn, may hold. Comments that repeat the code or tell the story of the edit are never allowed.

allowDocstrings.title: Allow docstrings
allowDocstrings.description: Skip a docstring that sits right on a declaration. Off, a docstring is judged like any other comment.

noComments.title: Remove all comments
noComments.description: Flag every comment Claude adds, docstrings included, and have Claude delete it at the end of the turn. Tool directives, shebangs and licence lines stay.

notify.title: Show a toast
notify.description: Show a toast when the mod flags comments in an edit or sends Claude back at the end of a turn.
